name: Scarlet Crusade
summary: Born from the shattered remnants of the Knights of the Silver Hand, the Scarlet Crusade is a fanatical holy order obsessed with purging the undead from Lordaeron. Blighted by paranoia and radical zealotry, they view anyone outside their ranks as carriers of the plague and shoot outsiders on sight. From strongholds across Tirisfal Glades and the Plaguelands, their crimson banners wage a ruthless war against Scourge and living alike.

sections.title: Rise from the Ashes
sections.body: When Prince Arthas betrayed Lordaeron and murdered King Terenas Menethil II, the Order of the Silver Hand was broken. Surviving paladins and priests rallied under leaders like Alexandros Mograine, Saidan Dathrohan, and General Abbendis to reclaim their ruined homeland. Reorganizing their forces at Hearthglen and Tyr's Hand, they swore to cleanse the undead scourge with holy fire. Yet as the war dragged on, tragedy and suspicion festered within their ranks. A faction led by Abbendis grew bitterly intolerant of non-human races, insisting that the fate of Lordaeron was the burden of mankind alone. What began as a desperate resistance soon devolved into an unyielding, xenophobic crusade.

sections.title: The Great Schism
sections.body: As the Crusade's dogma hardened into religious madness, moderate commanders recoiled. Lord Maxwell Tyrosus and his followers argued that retaking the north required alliances across Azeroth, seeking aid from the dwarves, gnomes, and night elves. Rejected by the zealots, Tyrosus and other disillusioned knights abandoned the order to form the Argent Dawn, remaining faithful to the pure, inclusive tenants of the Holy Light. Meanwhile, the Scarlet Crusade seized the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades as their heart of power, slaughtering travelers and refugees under the hysterical belief that all who walk the Plaguelands carry the Scourge's contagion.

sections.title: A Puppet in Crimson
sections.body: The Crusade's extreme descent into butchery was not entirely of their own making. During an assault on Stratholme, Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan was separated from his men and quietly murdered by the dreadlord Balnazzar. Possessing Dathrohan's corpse, the demon assumed direct control over the Scarlet ranks. Balnazzar subtly fueled their paranoia, orchestrating the murder of Highlord Alexandros Mograine through the jealousy of his son Renault. Behind grand speeches of purity and righteous fury, the crusaders serve as unknowing puppets to the very demonic darkness they believe the Light calls them to destroy.

faq.q: Why is the Scarlet Crusade hostile to everyone?
aliases: why does scarlet crusade attack me
faq.answer: The Crusade has succumbed to extreme paranoia after the fall of Lordaeron. They believe that anyone who has spent time in northern Lordaeron without being cleansed by their order is an active or latent carrier of the plague of undeath. To preserve their vision of pure humanity, they execute all outsiders on sight.

faq.q: Where did the Scarlet Crusade come from?
faq.answer: They originated from surviving knights and priests of the Knights of the Silver Hand after Lordaeron fell during the Third War. Regrouping in Hearthglen and the Scarlet Monastery under figures like Saidan Dathrohan and Alexandros Mograine, they pledged to eradicate the Scourge by any means necessary.

faq.q: How is the Scarlet Crusade different from the Argent Dawn?
aliases: difference between scarlet and argent dawn
faq.answer: Both orders splintered from the original Silver Hand, but while the Argent Dawn accepts all races and remains true to the compassionate virtues of the Light, the Scarlet Crusade became a fanatical, human-supremacist cult that massacres refugees and travelers under the guise of holy cleansing.

faq.q: Where are the Scarlet Crusade's main bases located?
faq.answer: Their primary bastion is the Scarlet Monastery in northeastern Tirisfal Glades. They also control the fortified town of Hearthglen in the Western Plaguelands, Tyr's Hand in the east, and the Scarlet Bastion inside the ruins of Stratholme, alongside numerous scout towers across the region.

faq.q: Who actually leads the Scarlet Crusade?
aliases: who is leader of scarlet crusade
faq.answer: Outwardly, Grand Crusader Saidan Dathrohan commands the Crusade from Stratholme, supported by High General Brigitte Abbendis and High Inquisitor Sally Whitemane at the Monastery. In truth, Dathrohan was killed and possessed by the nathrezim Balnazzar, who manipulates the entire order from the shadows.

faq.q: Can the Scarlet Crusaders still use the Holy Light if they are evil?
aliases: why can scarlets use the light
faq.answer: Yes. In the cosmology of the Light, wielding its power does not require moral goodness, but absolute, unwavering conviction and faith. The crusaders genuinely believe their brutal crusade is pure and just, allowing them to channel holy wrath despite their cruelty.

angles.text: The Scarlet Crusade represents the darkest perversion of the Silver Hand's teachings, demonstrating how righteous conviction can twist into tyrannical fanaticism without humility and compassion.
The Scarlet Crusade is the Forsaken's most immediate living nemesis, contesting the borders of Tirisfal Glades and actively hunting any undead who break free from the Lich King's grasp.
Though they wear the armor and speak the language of fallen Lordaeron, the Scarlet Crusade considers the modern Alliance compromised and executes Alliance emissaries without hesitation.
Studying the Crusade reveals the terrifying potency of faith stripped of moral restraint, where holy scripture is used to justify ruthless inquisitions and village purges.
